title: Scope.
officialText: The provisions of this section shall apply to high-pressure steam piping system, which is defined as a system operating at a steam pressure of more than 15 psi (103 kPa), and high temperature water intended for operation at pressures in excess of 160 psi (827 kPa) and temperatures in excess of 250°F (101°C). For purposes of this section, loops, bends or offsets of the piping shall not be considered expansion joints.
